name: Everglow adds 2 bounces to Radiant Cascade (#2310)
contract: Everglow 704565 (SpellFamilyName 33) has one live effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS) and EffectBasePoints 1 -> real 2, and EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 0x8000 (32768). Radiant Cascade's base spell (500141) carries SpellFamilyFlags_1 32768 -- the same bit -- and its own EffectChainTarget_1 is 4 (its own tooltip: 'jumps to up to 4 additional allies'), so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod admits it. Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets reads maxTargets = Effects[i].ChainTarget then calls modOwner->ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, maxTargets) before searching secondary targets, so the talent's own contribution is added straight onto Radiant Cascade's own chain count: 4 -> 6, exactly the tooltip's '2 additional allies'. The 'spell_modifier' query metric calls this same native path directly. Native handlers only; regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without Everglow, Radiant Cascade keeps its own 4 chain targets
Everglow adds 2 more, for 6 chain targets total
